mentions.name: ReadControl
mentions.description: A free and open-source read-later app for macOS, built around an engine written in Rust so that clients for other operating systems can be implemented later.
mentions.problem: Existing read-later apps did not fulfill the author's needs, prompting them to build their own.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building a free and open-source read-later macOS app. https://readcontrol.app

I used many different read-later apps, and none of them fulfilled my needs, so I decided to create my own. The engine is written in Rust so other OS clients can be implemented later.
mentions.author: boniattirodrigo
